name: QTT Expiry Item
description: Expiry register: tokens, keys, domains, subscriptions — anything that stops working on a date. Reminders go to the ops Telegram; QTT Admin › Servers lists them.

fields.label: What
fields.description: e.g. GitHub token for n8n (QTT-AI-OS read-only)

fields.label: Kind
fields.options:
Access token
API key
Domain
Certificate
Subscription
Payment card
Other

fields.label: Remind me
fields.description: Telegram at 30, 14, 7, 3 and 1 days, on the day and once expired. Untick for something being let go.

fields.label: Used by
fields.description: What stops working when it expires, e.g. n8n › QTT Daily Report.

fields.label: How to renew
fields.description: Where to go and what to change afterwards. Never put the secret itself here.

fields.label: Domain to look up
fields.description: For a domain: its name (e.g. queentouchtech.in). The date then updates by itself from the public registry every day, so a renewal ends the reminders.
